mass_high_dose.rejection_reason: Built/probed once on 2026-10-23 and rejected before any submission, rasters and ledger rows removed: (a) fifo 10/20/40% -- the parent's stored 8-connected FIFO-BFS order deletes one south-east corner; at 40% it empties 41% of 5 km blocks in a single contiguous 632-block hole, i.e. a region-isolated file under Hard Constraint #5 that confounds dose with geography; (b) shadow 50% -- the deepest shadow dose starts emptying whole contiguous regions (largest emptied cluster 17 blocks = 425 km2). The deep arm therefore stops at 48%, the largest shadow dose whose candidate passes the region-evenness gate. The same FIFO defect applies to any sibling MASS dose built with that stored order.
